category_title: Underprepared writers who procrastinate on topic selection and narrowing
scenario_title: Cognitive Exertion During Peer Review and Revision
minimal_context: The student is participating in a peer-review workshop group to critique drafts and revise their own research paper.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that you have received critiques on your draft from your peer-review group, please begin the revision process for your research paper.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I guess I always thought revision was about fixing spelling. It's like I don't even know what to call what I was doing all through high school.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Take a look at the comments your peers left on your draft and see what you can do.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I always thought that peer review was a big waste of time because only the teacher’s opinion matters anyway. When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to make the changes they suggested.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Revising is way harder than I ever thought. It's just headwork. Revising is like giving yourself the worst headache you’ve ever had in your life, like squeezing out your brain cells on paper.

task.content: Critiquing three separate drafts of their peers’ research papers, and receiving extensive critique on their own assignment drafts.
task.learning_goal: To sponsor the learning advantages associated with small groups.

context.environment: Each classroom hosted a peer-review workshop group.
context.social_setting: Small groups in one of nine classrooms.
context.time_context: At the conclusion of the program

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: Engaging in the revision process for a 15-page research paper and confronting prior misconceptions about what revision entails.
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Dubbed revising as 'headwork' and described revising as 'squeezing out your brain cells on paper.'
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Perceived college as an 'everyone-for-him-or-herself' culture; felt revising is way harder than ever thought.
related_quotes: Revising is like giving yourself the worst headache you’ve ever had in your life.
When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.

behavior_patterns.condition: At the onset of the program when facing academic struggles.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Perceived college as an 'everyone-for-him-or-herself' culture and avoided seeking help from peers.
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Always thought that peer review was a big waste of time because only the teacher’s opinion matters anyway.
related_quotes: When you’re drowning, the last person you think to turn to is someone else who doesn’t know how to swim.
